title: World Finance Forum Dublin 2026
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
**Vertex is proud to participate in the World Finance Forum Dublin 2026, bringing together senior finance leaders to discuss the opportunities and challenges shaping the future of finance.**


As part of the event, Vertex will host an executive roundtable, **Beyond E-Invoicing: Preparing Finance for Europe's Digital Future** , exploring how ViDA, e-invoicing mandates, digital customs initiatives, and other emerging EU regulations are accelerating finance transformation across Europe


The discussion will examine how organisations can move beyond compliance to unlock greater visibility, control, and efficiency across finance operations. Attendees will share experiences from digital transformation initiatives across Europe, explore the impact of increasing transaction transparency on business performance, and discuss practical steps for preparing systems, processes, and data for the next wave of regulatory change.


If you're looking to strengthen your finance transformation strategy, navigate evolving compliance requirements, or build a future-ready finance function, we invite you to join the conversation with Vertex at World Finance Forum Dublin 2026.


For more information, please visit:[World Finance Forum Dublin 2026 - Tickets](https://events.futureforums.com/world-finance-forum-dublin)
